title: K001: Add 15 new endpoint handlers to mock API
summary: All 16 new handlers registered with method-prefixed patterns and method-not-allowed fallbacks. 20 atomic counters (4 existing + 16 new) declared, loaded in Assertions(), serialized with snake_case JSON tags. Request body capture infrastructure (captureBody, LastRequestBody, GET /test/last-request/{endpoint}) implemented correctly with RWMutex protection. Existing register/heartbeat handlers updated to use captureBody. 67 tests pass with -race, 0 failures. go vet clean. golangci-lint reports 3 errcheck violations that must be fixed before merge.

tests_checklist.item: Each new handler has happy-path + wrong-method tests
TestConcurrentCounters extended to 20 endpoint types x 100 goroutines
TestLastRequestBody_InitiallyEmpty and TestLastRequestBody_StoredAfterCapture test programmatic API

code_quality_checklist.item: Follows existing handler pattern (captureBody -> decode -> increment -> respond)
New handlers use writeJSON() for consistent JSON responses
204 handlers use w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent) with no body
snake_case JSON tags on all AssertionCounters fields
Test body constants follow registerBody/heartbeatBody naming pattern
doRequest helper reduces test boilerplate for PUT requests
No code duplication beyond acceptable handler boilerplate

security_checklist.item: No hardcoded secrets (mock values only in test code)
No SQL injection risk (no database access)
No path traversal risk (path values used as map keys only)
io.ReadAll on request body (acceptable for test mock, not production)

architecture_checklist.item: Solution is minimal - handlers follow existing pattern
Request body capture is cleanly separated from handler logic

dry_yagni_checklist.item: No unused code or dead code
Handler boilerplate is acceptable for this pattern

defensive_checklist.item: Map initialized in New() (no nil map panic)

issues_found.description: golangci-lint errcheck: return value of s.captureBody('deregister', r) is not checked. handleDeregister ignores the error from captureBody, unlike all other handlers that check it.
issues_found.fix: Add error check: `if _, err := s.captureBody("deregister", r); err != nil { writeJSON(w, http.StatusBadRequest, map[string]string{"error": "invalid request body"}); return }` — or simply assign to `_, _ =` if intentionally ignoring (deregister has no body to decode). Preferred: use `_, _ = s.captureBody("deregister", r)` to explicitly discard since deregister sends no body per the plan.

issues_found.description: golangci-lint errcheck: return value of w.Write in handleArtifact is not checked.
issues_found.fix: Assign to blank identifier: `_, _ = w.Write([]byte("mock-plexd-binary-v0.0.0"))` — consistent with how writeJSON handles the encoder error via slog, but for a test mock, explicitly discarding is acceptable.

issues_found.description: golangci-lint errcheck: return value of w.Write in handleLastRequest is not checked.

suggested_improvements: Minor: The plan references '19 counters' but implementation has 20 (4 existing + 16 new). The plan's count appears to be off-by-one — the code is correct with all listed endpoints covered.
Minor (D2): handleDeregister could benefit from a one-line comment explaining why it doesn't decode a request body (client sends nil body per endpoints.go:67-70).
next_steps: Fix 3 errcheck violations in mockapi.go:384, :573, :636 — add `_, _ =` prefix or proper error handling
Re-run `go test -race ./test/e2e/mockapi/...` to confirm tests still pass after fixes
